holes.name: OnApproximationOfReals.theorem_1_1
holes.body:
/--
Statement of Theorem 1.1:

Let `n` be an integer such that `n ≥ 2`. For any transcendental real number `ξ`, we have
`ω⋆_n(ξ) ≥ a * n`, where `a = 1 / (2 - log 2)`.
-/
theorem theorem_1_1 (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≥ 2) (ξ : ℝ) (hξ : Transcendental ℚ ξ) :
    letI a : ℝ := 1 / (2 - Real.log 2)
    (ω⋆ n ξ : EReal) ≥ (a : EReal) * n := by
  sorry
